messages:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding sample app caused duplicate Stripe charges when client retried on 429s + SW replay. Repro on Chrome with fast reload.

maria: Repro steps: click pay -> SW intercepts POST /v1/checkout -> server briefly returns 429 -> sample's retry logic immediately re-fires -> SW also replays queued fetch -> two requests accepted.

devon: Is the browser SDK inserting Idempotency-Key today?

sanjay: No, only server SDKs auto-add keys. Browser SDK leaves it to apps because of cross-tab/persistent storage complexity.

olivia: Suggestion: short-term fix = sample app should NOT retry on 429 unless idempotency key present. Medium-term: JS SDK opt-in auto-idempotency + in-memory replay guard + SW hooks.

maria: I pushed a quick patch to stop retrying on 429 in the sample app; verified no dup charges in tests.

devon: SDK design notes: - default retry: exponential backoff with full jitter - always honor Retry-After header - if side-effecting endpoint and no Idempotency-Key, do not auto-retry 429s. Provide opt-in auto-idempotency that generates UUID keys.

sanjay: For SW dedupe we can expose sdk.peekInFlight(key) and use BroadcastChannel to sync in-flight keys across tabs. Keep an LRU store TTL ~45s.

olivia: Telemetry: emit event when SDK attaches idemp key and when SDK blocks a retry due to missing key. Add DEBUG flag for dev logs.

ci-bot: build #4922 started for branch fix/onboarding-retry-filter (unit+e2e).

maria: Thanks — once SDK hooks land we'll add SW snippet to onboarding docs and run an e2e against Stripe test mode.
